core_principle: V2 never re-configures heroes/troops per march by default. Pick the preset slot for the task, verify it loaded, dispatch.

use_for: high-risk active attacks needing max power

slot_selection_rule: JOIN picks any AVAILABLE slot from pool [2..7]; not fixed rotation. Returning marches flip back to AVAILABLE.

parallel_model.joined_rallies: FORMATION_2..7 continuously, unlimited join count but per-march availability checked
parallel_model.note: unlimited JOIN_RALLY ≠ unlimited troops; hero/troop/formation occupancy still observed

identity_rule: slot index + fingerprint + role_id; OCR custom labels (打野/杰西/熊6…) are auxiliary evidence only and may change
per_role_isolation: ROLE_A and ROLE_B each learn their own 8 fingerprints; mechanism shared, fingerprints/occupancy not shared; role-specific overrides saved if slots differ from defaults

elements.FORMATION_PRESET_BAR: top row: 8 preset slots + save icon; 640-space y~103, x centres ~[55,121,187,253,319,385,451,517], save ~575
elements.TROOP_ROWS: 盾兵/矛兵/射手 rows with counts and sliders
elements.bottom_tools: 全部撤回 / 平均配置 / 比例分配 / 士兵比例 44%/21%/35%

select_verifier: FORMATION_SELECTED(slot) requires >=1 signal: selected-state UI on preset bar / hero combo change / hero fingerprint change / troop fingerprint change; only then DISPATCH allowed

generic_skill.name: SELECT_FORMATION_SLOT
generic_skill.forbidden: no BEAR_FORMATION_n / per-event copies; one parameterized pipeline for all activities

fast_loop_change: JOIN -> PAGE_FORMATION -> select AVAILABLE preset -> verify -> DISPATCH; no per-rally HERO/TROOP dynamic analysis
risk_boundary: FormationPolicy only decides WHICH slot; attack/风险 decisions stay with existing activity/risk strategy (e.g. FOUNDRY_ATTACK_CITY remains high-risk gated)

ROLE_B_xhw_1061663148.note: fingerprint scan verified slot taps change loadout; matches user semantics

stamina_rules.principle: 出征按钮里的「罐头+数字」只在本次出征消耗体力时出现；它是体力消耗的唯一视觉证据
stamina_rules.policy_effect: 罐头出现 => 强制 FORMATION_1 STAMINA_EFFICIENT；罐头不存在时不得按体力任务处理
stamina_rules.detector: winter_agent_v2.formation_policy.stamina_cost_visible(frame) -> None=无罐头 / 数字=消耗量
